The '''2018 Ralltiir Regionals''' were the regional championship for Germany, Austria and Switzerland, held on 16 June 2018 in Munich, Germany. Nine players entered. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won, beating [[Angelo Consoli]] in the final.<ref name="ral">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=67845 Ralltiir Regional (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) - Sat 16/JUN/2018 - Munich, Germany], forum.starwarsccg.org (11 December 2017 – 30 June 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004116/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t67845.html Internet Archive]</ref>
